limitations: L4 denotes offline synthetic software acceptance only; no instrument, product or scientific validity is established.
Cumulative interpolation assumes uniform mass within bins and uses recorded tails; midpoint means are in-range approximations using spherical-volume scaling.
Technical replicates do not increase independent sample n. Disagreeing replicates and fewer than two reliable measurements yield unavailable sample summaries.
Hashes cannot establish historical freeze timing or source independence; independent review always remains unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, quality, stabil*, stabl*, perform*, approv*, certif*, compliance and compliant. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims; computed agreement and review approval cannot support positive claims; this single synthetic fixture cannot establish replication.
Read-only inputs are bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlinks share initial reads and parsing.
